notes: Versioned on purpose. Adding an entry changes what the product will ship, so it is a reviewable change with a stated reason, not a constant buried in a source file. `phrase` is matched literally on word boundaries, case-insensitively. `pattern` is a JavaScript regex source, used where the tell is a shape rather than a string.
